name: knowledge-base
description: Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) memory. Stores and retrieves knowledge using vector search.

save_knowledge.description: Save a fact, note, or memory to the vector database for long-term recall. Supports [[Topic]] linking.

topic.description: Optional category or main topic name

query_knowledge.description: Search the knowledge base for information about a topic or question.

query.description: The question or topic to search for

record_observation.description: Save a structured observation (fact, error, success, milestone) with semantic concepts for long-term recall.

observation.description: The distilled facts or events to record

concepts.description: List of semantic tags or topics related to this observation (e.g. ['python', 'bug-fix', 'mlx'])

update_project_timeline.description: Update the human-readable PROMETHEUS.md file in the project root with a summary of recent progress.

summary.description: Concise summary of what was accomplished in this session
